home.title: Community incident map
home.subtitle: Moderated first-hand reports of robbery, snatching and theft in Dhaka.
home.disclaimer: A highlighted area shows a concentration of published community reports — not a measure of personal risk. An area with no reports is not labelled safe.

report.title: Report an incident
report.emergencyNotice: If you are in immediate danger, contact emergency services first. This platform does not dispatch police.
report.intro: Share a first-hand account. Your report stays anonymous to the public and is reviewed before it appears on the map.
report.experienceHint: Describe the sequence of events and context. Do not include names, phone numbers or details that could identify anyone.
report.consentLabel: I agree to the reporting rules and to anonymous public publication of a reviewed version.
report.prototypeNotice: Prototype — this flow is not yet connected to the backend.

receipt.title: Report received
receipt.body: Your report has been received and is awaiting review. It will appear on the map after approval.
receipt.statusLink: Keep this private link to track your report.
